item.title: T-Mobile awards Johnstown $50K grant to assist with new community park
item.description: JOHNSTOWN, Pa. (WTAJ) -- T-Mobile announced that the Johnstown Redevelopment Authority (JRA) is the latest recipient of its Hometown Grant, which will award the authority $50,000. item.title: Huntingdon Jewish synagogue to be repurposed into events venue
item.description: HUNTINGDON, Pa. (WTAJ) — An old Jewish synagogue is being repurposed into a community events venue.
